_comment: Approved effort shape: values/default/native_parameter validated together (default inside values, known protocol). Baseline rejects [capabilities] at startup.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "m-a"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o"

[capabilities.overrides."m-a".reasoning.effort]
supported = true
values = ["low", "high"]
default = "high"
native_parameter = { protocol = "openai-chat", path = "reasoning_effort" }
name: m4_capability_override_effort_approved_shape
